title: Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2611.18149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the g

translated_title: 哪个模型，用于哪个变量？稀疏ICU时间序列中的逐变量预测组合
translated_abstract: 临床预测论文通常只报告单一的最佳架构。我们发现在多变量ICU生理指标预测中，这一问题掩盖了变量之间的差异：没有任何一种架构在所有变量上都是最优的，哪个模型胜出会随变量而变化。我们在五个ICU数据库（MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV、eICU、HiRID以及UMM（曼海姆大学医学中心，一个德国单中心ICU））上，使用包含14个模型的模型池对94个生理通道进行24小时时间跨度的预测，并采用逐变量拟合的权重对这些模型的预测进行组合。在测试集上，该组合方法在所有五个数据库上均优于最佳单一模型，均方误差降低6.1%至11.0%（平均8.7%）。增益主要集中在临床数据最稀疏的地方：最稀疏的三分之一通道提升了11.9%，实验室检验值提升了7.5%，而最密集的三分之一通道仅提升3.1%。对每个变量表现最好的五个模型采用基于排名的调和加权——完全无需拟合任何权重——即可恢复约五分之四的增益。
tldr: 研究发现ICU生理指标预测中不存在对所有变量都最优的单一模型，通过在五个ICU数据库上对94个变量逐变量组合14个模型的预测，平均可将均方误差较最佳单一模型降低8.7%，且增益集中在数据最稀疏的变量上。
en_tdlr: No single architecture is best for every ICU physiological variable; combining 14 models with per-variable weights across five ICU databases reduces MSE by an average of 8.7% over the best single model, with the largest gains on the sparsest channels.
